verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Unreal Engine is a vendor-operated product with accounts, editor tooling and online services, so a buyer could fairly ask whether project or user data is excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-usage policy, telemetry controls or an AI-training opt-out. The docs cover scripting, plugins, cooking, networking and Remote Control, and the probes cover machine-readability and MCP availability, so this is absence of evidence rather than a category error.
